# klygo

> A unified, high-performance Python toolkit for file operations, archives, configuration, dataset management, and zero-shot object detection pipelines.

Klygo provides modular functional APIs and selected stateful interfaces across 12 public modules plus end-to-end integration workflows.

## Documentation

- [Files and Path Operations](docs/files/README.md): Path construction (`files.path`), filesystem operations (`mkdir`, `remove`, `copy`, `move`), structured data I/O (JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV, ENV), hashing (`hash`), and chunked streaming downloads (`download`).
- [Archive Operations](docs/archive/README.md): Create, inspect, extract, search, verify, merge, and split ZIP, TAR, GZip, 7z (`py7zr`), and RAR (`rarfile`) archives with path traversal protection.
- [Configuration](docs/config/README.md): Multi-format configuration management (YAML, JSON, TOML, ENV) with dot-path notation (`config.get`, `config.set`), validation, and object-oriented `Config` access.
- [Dataset Operations](docs/datasets/README.md): YOLO dataset management: inspect statistics (`info`), load annotations (`load`), partition (`partition`), repartition (`repartition`), unpartition (`unpartition`), merge (`merge`), split (`split`), and remap class IDs (`remap_classes`).
- [Media Operations](docs/media/README.md): Zero-RAM video and image reading (`media.load(..., stream=True)`), frame iteration (`iter_frames`), video probing (`probe`), and conversion to NumPy/PIL/Tensor (`to_array`, `to_pil`, `to_tensor`).
- [Model Registry & Inference](docs/models/README.md): Unified AI model registry, auto-download, backend routing (Transformers, Ultralytics, Torchvision, KerasHub), and inference execution (`models.load`).
- [Standardized Detection Outputs](docs/outputs/README.md): Standardized detection collections (`Box`, `Crops`, `Detection`, `Detections`) with built-in cropping, coordinate restoration, filtering, and serialization.
- [Postprocessing Pipelines](docs/postprocessing/README.md): Composable postprocessing operations: Non-Maximum Suppression (`nms`, `suppress`), confidence thresholding (`threshold`, `filter_score`), box clipping (`clip`, `clip_boxes`), and top-k selection (`top`).
- [Preprocessing Transforms](docs/preprocessing/README.md): Composable, lazy image transformations, color grading, geometric warping, normalization, and automatic spatial coordinate tracking (`trace`).
- [Utilities](docs/utils/README.md): Formatting helpers (`human_size`), string conversions, and interactive Rich progress bars (`ProgressBar`).
- [Runtime Validators](docs/validators/README.md): Strict runtime type and value validation (`validate_type`).
- [Visualization](docs/visual/README.md): Draw bounding boxes with labels and scores (`draw_bboxes`), preview images (`show_image`), and plot dataset class distributions (`plot_dataset_stats`).
- [Integration Workflows](docs/integration/README.md): End-to-end integration workflows testing authentic pretrained models against Ground Truth labels on Colab GPU or CPU.

## Guidance for coding assistants

1. **Import facades**: Always import public APIs through top-level package facades:
   `from klygo import archive, config, datasets, files, media, models, outputs, postprocessing, preprocessing, utils, validators, visual`
2. **Cross-module dogfooding**: Never call raw `pathlib.Path`, `os.path`, or `shutil` directly in user-facing code or examples when a native `klygo.files` API exists (`files.path`, `files.save`, `files.load`, `files.mkdir`, `files.copy`, `files.remove`, `files.join`, etc.).
3. **Pure documentation boundary**: The `docs/` tree strictly contains `.md` Markdown files. Never place test scripts or Python bytecode (`__pycache__`) in `docs/`.
4. **Clean separation of code and artifacts**: Never place generated outputs, raw datasets, zip archives, or caches inside source or test directories. Put all artifacts under `artifacts/` (e.g. `artifacts/integration/<run-id>/`).
5. **English-only language policy**:
   - All exception messages (`raise ValueError(...)`, `raise TypeError(...)`, etc.) must strictly be written in clear, concise English.
   - All docstrings, parameter descriptions, return types, and code comments must strictly be written in English.
6. **Local model construction**: When building integration workflows or custom models, subclass `klygo.models.detection.base.Detector` or `BaseModel` and run authentic pretrained weights locally.
7. **Hardware acceleration**: Workflows must support automatic hardware dispatch:
   `device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"`
   On Google Colab, document switching runtime via **Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU**.
8. **File and archive inputs**: All file and archive APIs accept `str` and `os.PathLike[str]` inputs. Pass `overwrite=True` when replacing existing files or archives.
